content.value_statement: Nature manuscript skills need consistent journal rules, ethics guidance, and quality checks. This package supplies shared references and a local consistency checker.
actual_capabilities: Provides submission guidance for Nature, Nature Communications, and Nature Machine Intelligence.
Supplies shared rules for research ethics, compliance, terminology, and main-text structure.
Defines reader priorities and manuscript paper-type categories for consuming Nature skills.
Checks text files for terminology variants, inconsistent numeric precision, and equivalent length units.
Produces readable warnings or machine-readable consistency results for local review.
limitations: This package is a dependency and does not provide a standalone user workflow.
Journal requirements can change, so users must verify current official instructions.
Consistency findings are warnings and require contextual human review.
The checker does not validate scientific claims, statistics, citations, or submission portals.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Nature manuscript
use_cases.description: Apply shared structure, ethics, and journal-format references while drafting a manuscript.
use_cases.target_user: Researchers using a Nature writing skill

use_cases.title: Polish a revised paper
use_cases.description: Find terminology drift, precision changes, unit variants, and repeated claims after several revisions.

use_cases.title: Check submission readiness
use_cases.description: Review format, availability statements, compliance duties, and supporting material requirements for the selected journal.

prompt_templates.title: Select journal guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Within my Nature writing workflow, load the shared guidance for [journal] and list the requirements relevant to [article type].
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with the correct journal and article type.

prompt_templates.title: Review reader flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the shared reader workflow to assess this abstract for relevance, novelty, trust, reuse, and boundaries: [abstract].
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve how a broad scientific audience understands an abstract.

prompt_templates.title: Run a consistency review
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the shared consistency sweep to [manuscript files]. Report terminology, numeric precision, equivalent units, claims, and redundancy that need human review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Audit a manuscript after multiple editing rounds.

prompt_templates.title: Audit submission readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the shared [journal] format and compliance references, audit [manuscript package]. Separate confirmed gaps, contextual warnings, and requirements needing official verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Perform an advanced review before journal submission.

output_examples.input: Review this abstract for broad Nature readers.
output: Relevance appears early, but the novelty is delayed until the final sentence.
Move the main conclusion before technical method details.
Add one sentence defining the result boundary and intended reuse.

output_examples.input: Check the revised manuscript for consistency.
output: Terminology warning: both “this study” and “this work” describe the same manuscript.
Precision warning: the same score appears as 8.26 and 8.260.
Unit warning: one length appears as 35 mm and 3.5 cm. Confirm whether both references describe the same quantity.

best_practices: Load only the shared file required by the active Nature skill.
Confirm the journal and article type before applying format rules.
Review every automated warning in context before changing manuscript text.
anti_patterns: Do not invoke this dependency as a standalone writing workflow.
Do not combine requirements from different Nature journals.
Do not treat consistency warnings as automatic corrections.

faq.question: Can I use this skill by itself?
faq.answer: No. It is a shared dependency for other installed Nature skills.

faq.question: Which journals are covered?
faq.answer: It includes references for Nature, Nature Communications, and Nature Machine Intelligence.

faq.question: What does the consistency checker detect?
faq.answer: It detects selected terminology variants, numeric precision differences, and equivalent lengths expressed in different units.

faq.question: Does the checker edit my manuscript?
faq.answer: No. It reports warnings for human review and leaves source files unchanged.

faq.question: Does it guarantee journal compliance?
faq.answer: No. Journal policies change, and official instructions remain authoritative.

faq.question: Can it review confidential manuscripts safely?
faq.answer: The references advise using secured systems and avoiding uploads to public models. Users remain responsible for data handling.
